skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the goals, requirements, and content of urban development planning.
Understand the goals, requirements, and content of rural development planning.
Develop strategic plans for urban and rural areas including spatial development models and infrastructure.
Conduct environmental impact assessments for urban and rural development projects.
Create prioritized investment plans and resource allocation strategies for urban and rural development.
Propose balanced and harmonious solutions for urban and rural development that align with sustainable development goals.
